ios-specialized|File management.summary: Plenix on iOS shows files and folders the way the web does and leaves choosing, opening and saving to the system: the document picker and the document browser, Quick Look for previews, the share sheet for sending. A file is its type’s symbol (or a thumbnail from QuickLookThumbnailing), its name with the extension kept in view when a long name is cut, and its size and date in Reddit Mono; a folder is the folder symbol, its name in DM Sans and its count. In a list each file is a row with its facts and a trailing menu of Rename, Download and Delete; during a transfer the row shows a linear progress view and Cancel. Apple’s default is the system list row; Plenix keeps the row, its swipe actions and its context menu and changes the look.

anatomy.name: Type symbol or thumbnail
anatomy.about: The type’s symbol in the muted color, or a small thumbnail from QuickLookThumbnailing.

anatomy.name: Name
anatomy.about: The stored name in Reddit Mono; a long name is cut in the middle so the extension stays.

anatomy.name: Facts
anatomy.about: The size (ByteCountFormatter) and the date, muted, in Reddit Mono; a folder’s count.

anatomy.name: Selection
anatomy.about: The list’s own selection in edit mode.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.about: A trailing menu with Rename, Download and Delete, the same actions as swipe actions and in the context menu.
